image.name: phpmyadmin
image.description: [Phpmyadmin](https://github.com/phpmyadmin/phpmyadmin/) is a free software tool written in PHP, intended to handle the administration of MySQL over the Web. phpMyAdmin supports a wide range of operations on MySQL and MariaDB.

changelog.desc: Add support for mTLS. Existing users will need to delete their config.inc.php and restart the container.
Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid http2 deprecation warnings.
Existing users should update: site-confs/default.conf - Cleanup default site conf.
Rebasing to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.
Rebasing to Alpine 3.15 with php8. Restructure nginx configs ([see changes announcement](https://info.linuxserver.io/issues/2022-08-20-nginx-base)).

env_vars.name: PMA_ARBITRARY
env_vars.desc: Set to `1` to allow you to connect to any server. Setting to `0` will only allow you to connect to specified hosts (See Application Setup)

env_vars.name: PMA_ABSOLUTE_URI
env_vars.desc: Set the URL you will use to access the web frontend

image.title: Phpmyadmin
image.setup_instructions:
This image uses nginx, in contrast to the official images which offer fpm-only or Apache variants.

We support all of the official [environment variables](https://docs.phpmyadmin.net/en/latest/setup.html#docker-environment-variables) for configuration as well as directly editing the config files.

For more information check out the [phpmyadmin documentation](https://www.phpmyadmin.net/docs/).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  phpmyadmin:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/phpmyadmin:latest
    container_name: phpmyadmin
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - PMA_ARBITRARY=1 #optional
      - PMA_ABSOLUTE_URI=https://phpmyadmin.example.com #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/phpmyadmin/config:/config
    ports:
      - 80:80
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=phpmyadmin \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e PMA_ARBITRARY=1 `#optional` \
  -e PMA_ABSOLUTE_URI=https://phpmyadmin.example.com `#optional` \
  -p 80:80 \
  -v /path/to/phpmyadmin/config:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/phpmyadmin:latest
